reason: The paper proves robustness certificates for contraction-constrained SSM safety heads and evaluates toxic-comment/jailbreak detection; a contraction penalty improves certified fraction and transfers across safety datasets. Its contribution is provable safety classification, not inference efficiency or sequence-model compression, so the shared SSM lineage is not enough for inclusion.
title: Bounded Reachability&Jailbreak Detection via Contraction-Constrained State Space Models
